name: cppbridge
description: Enterprise-grade modernization and translation engine for legacy and modern C/C++ (C89/C99/C11/C++11/C++17/C++20) scientific algorithms and systems code into idiomatic, vectorized scientific Python (NumPy, SciPy, Numba, Dataclasses) or compiled pybind11 C-extensions. Features automated de-pointerization, struct-to-dataclass conversion, OpenMP-to-Numba translation, C++ STL container decompilation, BLAS/LAPACK and Eigen modernization, Boost C++ library mappings (Boost.Math, Boost.Random, Boost.MultiArray), multi-file include DAG linking, and closed-loop equivalence verification.
